author: Akien
prose: trouble tickets need two fixes. (1) Live troubles live in CairnCommons/troubles/. Cleared ones move to ~/.cairn/logs/cairn/0/artifact_archive/trouble_tickets/ and age out on the same 30-day cycle as other artifacts. Location IS liveness — no field to misread. (2) All tickets share one workflow model. Trouble tickets have simple workflows (OPEN → CLEARED) but use the same schema for state tracking as development tickets — same inspector, same gate, same field names. "unified interface design where claude is the user." Triggered by CC checking the wrong field (cleared instead of standing) when compiling the inbox — two separate state models meant guessing which vocabulary applied.
